title: 打印发票
problem_statement_md:
假设你正在开发一个发票系统。
该系统有已定义好**invoice**()函数，它将发票号码作为参数并输出。
你需要为**invoice**()函数添加一个装饰器，并按示例格式打印发票。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Decorators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working on an invoicing system.
The system has an already defined [b]invoice[/b]() function, which takes the invoice number as argument and outputs it.
You need to add a decorator for the [b]invoice[/b]() function, that will print the invoice in the following format:

[b]Sample Input[/b]
42

[b]Sample Output[/b]
***
INVOICE #42
***
END OF PAGE 

[note]The given code takes the invoice number as input and passes it to the [b]invoice[/b]() function.[/note]
hint_md: 给出的代码输入发票号码，并传递给`invoice()`函数。
